description: Verify a Verifiable Credential (JSON-LD with a Data Integrity proof, a VC-JOSE compact JWS or an SD-JWT VC) with the platform's verifier: signature, issuer DID and key, status (revoked or suspended) and the trust of the issuer. Answers valid true or false with the stage-by-stage verdict. The credential is sent to the verifier as given; nothing is stored.

credential.description: the credential: a JSON-LD object as JSON text, a compact JWS or an SD-JWT

profile.description: trust profile: self (default), untp, gs1 or espr-authority

name: verify_credential
title: Verify a credential
